sources.name: Visit Detroit Detroit Hotel Guide
sources.geographic_coverage: Detroit metro: Downtown Detroit, Wayne County/Dearborn, Oakland County, Macomb County, DTW Airport
sources.limitations: The guide names hotels by neighborhood grouping and does not publish street addresses; identity confidence rests on the CVB's own unambiguous naming of a distinct property, not a transcribed address. Macomb County rows sourced here are boundary-excluded from this market.

sources.name: Destination Ann Arbor places-to-stay directory
sources.organization: Destination Ann Arbor / Washtenaw County CVB
sources.geographic_coverage: Ann Arbor, Ypsilanti, and surrounding Washtenaw County destinations
sources.limitations: The top-level hotels index is a JavaScript-rendered widget not readable as static HTML; individual /listing/ pages and the Ypsilanti/Saline/Chelsea surrounding-destination pages were readable and used directly. Not every listing page states a street address.

sources.name: Dearborn Area Chamber of Commerce member directory
sources.limitations: Directory search results reachable per-listing rather than as one paginated category export; treated as PARTIAL harvesting.

sources.name: Auburn Hills Chamber of Commerce hotels category
sources.geographic_coverage: Auburn Hills, Troy, Rochester, Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, Pontiac, Orion Township
sources.limitations: Members with addresses far outside the market (Mackinac Island, East Lansing) and at least one non-lodging member (an AV retailer) appear in the 'hotels' category and are excluded/flagged rather than trusted blindly.

sources.name: Vibe Credit Union Showplace official partner hotels
sources.organization: Vibe Credit Union Showplace (formerly Suburban Collection Showplace)
sources.geographic_coverage: Novi and Wixom, adjacent to the venue
sources.limitations: Only the anchor Hyatt Place listing carries a full street address on this page; the rest are named with distance-from-venue only.

sources.name: First-party brand locator pages (Wyndham/Hilton/IHG/Choice/Motel 6)
sources.limitations: Used only where a specific first-party property page URL was directly observed; every row from this source carries that real, unfabricated URL.

sources.name: Aggregated brand-locator discovery (no single directory page)
sources.organization: Multiple hotel brands, discovered via search aggregation
sources.geographic_coverage: Southfield, Troy, Auburn Hills gap-fill, Novi gap-fill, Farmington Hills, Livonia/Plymouth/Northville, Dearborn gap-fill, DTW gap-fill
sources.limitations: No single authoritative directory page exists for these suburbs; property names are corroborated across multiple booking aggregators citing the brand's own hotel, but no independently sourced street address was recovered. Every row from this source is IDENTITY_PROVISIONAL, the same treatment Pittsburgh gave its GPHA-only gap-fill rows.
